temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn has been unusually quiet and withdrawn over the past few days, despite normally being engaging. When Carolyn asks, Marilyn says she is overwhelmed by work and some personal stuff and thanks Carolyn for asking.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believed Marilyn was normally engaging and that her recent quietness might be connected to the busy, stressful week at the bank, but she did not know the cause.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn confirms that she is dealing with work and personal stress, not simply ordinary busyness.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes Marilyn is overwhelmed by work and personal issues and may need support, though Marilyn has not shared details.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer support and keep the door open for Marilyn to talk if she wants to.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn responded curtly in a later interaction, which confused and slightly hurt Carolyn. Carolyn shares her own experiences and says she hopes she did not overstep. Marilyn appreciates it, apologizes if she seemed off, and says it has been a hard week.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After her initial check-in, Carolyn believed Marilyn was stressed, but Marilyn's curt response made Carolyn wonder whether she had overstepped or whether Marilyn was upset with her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn clarifies that her curtness was due to a hard week, not to Carolyn's attempt to support her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes Marilyn's curtness was not personal and that Marilyn appreciates Carolyn's openness and support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To clear any misunderstanding and continue showing supportive openness.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Marilyn responded positively to Carolyn's openness, then accepted Carolyn's invitation to a small weekend gathering, saying it sounds lovely and that she would love to join.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Carolyn believed Marilyn appreciated her support and that their connection was becoming more positive, possibly developing into a friendship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Marilyn enthusiastically accepts a social invitation, indicating interest in spending time together outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes Marilyn is open to deepening their friendship and that their bond is strengthening.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To host the gathering and strengthen her friendship with Marilyn.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite friendly interactions outside work, Carolyn perceives Marilyn as still maintaining professional distance at the bank. When Carolyn raises this, Marilyn says she did not realize it, apologizes if it seemed that way, and agrees to talk about improving collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After the social invitation was accepted, Carolyn believed their friendship was growing and expected that warmth to carry into their work relationship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Carolyn notices a gap between their outside-work friendliness and Marilyn's professional distance at work; Marilyn denies intending distance and agrees to discuss it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes there is an unresolved work dynamic, but also that Marilyn is unaware of it and willing to talk and improve collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To directly address their work dynamic and work toward better collaboration.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After their private meeting, Carolyn believes they cleared the air and better understand each other's professional expectations and personal boundaries. She proposes teaming up on a new project proposal, and Marilyn says it is a great idea and that she looks forward to working more closely.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After agreeing to talk about the work distance, Carolyn believed there was an issue to resolve but felt Marilyn was open to improving their collaboration.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. The private meeting appears to have resolved Carolyn's concerns, and Marilyn responds positively to a closer collaborative partnership.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Carolyn believes they now understand each other better and that Marilyn is genuinely willing to work more closely with her.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To team up with Marilyn on the new project proposal and further their partnership.
